name: Rod of Lordly Might

source.note: Checked against the 2024 DMG's wording (aidedd.org's copy, 2026-10-17): the blade is a Longsword or Shortsword with no +3 of its own, the Battleaxe and Spear carry the +3, Paralyze and Drain Life are Constitution saves.

powers.name: Paralyze
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): the next creature you hit with a melee attack makes a DC 17 Constitution save or is Paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

powers.name: Terrify
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a DC 17 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute.

powers.name: Drain Life
powers.text: Arm it (once per dawn): the next creature you hit with a melee attack makes a DC 17 Constitution save or takes 4d6 Necrotic, and you regain half.

powers.name: Change form
powers.text: Bonus Action: press a button. The rod becomes a fiery Longsword or Shortsword (2d6 Fire on hits, bright light 40 ft), a +3 Battleaxe or a +3 Spear, each with that weapon's own properties and Mastery; the same form again, or Mace, returns it to a +3 Mace.

summary: +3 mace that becomes a fiery sword, a +3 axe or a +3 spear; once a day each: Paralyze, Terrify and Drain Life.
text: A flange-headed rod that is a magic Mace with +3 to attack and damage rolls. Six buttons line its haft, and pressing one is a Bonus Action. The first sprouts a blade of fire from the end opposite the head: the rod becomes a magic Longsword or Shortsword (your choice) that adds 2d6 Fire damage on a hit and sheds Bright Light out to 40 feet and Dim Light another 40 feet. The second and third make it a magic Battleaxe or Spear, each with a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls; as any of these it has that weapon's properties and its Weapon Mastery, if you have chosen it. The other three buttons make a climbing pole, a battering ram and a compass, which the game doesn't model. A button's form lasts until you press another button or the same one again, and then the rod is a Mace once more. Paralyze: when you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force a DC 17 Constitution saving throw; on a failure it is Paralyzed for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Drain Life: when you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force a DC 17 Constitution saving throw; on a failure it takes 4d6 extra Necrotic damage and you regain Hit Points equal to half of it. Terrify: as a Magic action, each creature you choose within 30 feet that you can see makes a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or is Frightened of you for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Paralyze, Terrify and Drain Life each work once, then recharge separately at the next dawn.
